name: Round Timer
desc: Heavy-bag round timer: warm-up, rounds and breaks, a combo for each round, and optional exercises.
about: Set a warm-up, the number of rounds and the round and break lengths in 15-second steps. The clock fills the screen and turns green for a round, orange with 30 seconds left and red at 10. Each round gets a heavy-bag combo, shown during the break before it. Add a guided warm-up and a few strength and cardio exercises (a finisher, or one between rounds) chosen from what you have at home, and a stats page follows the session.

intents.desc: Rounds, breaks and a combo for each round, with the clock filling the screen.

intents.phrase: …get a combo to work on each round
intents.desc: A bank of 35 heavy-bag combos, one per round, with the ones that hurt left out.

intents.phrase: …add some strength and cardio to my boxing session
intents.desc: Exercises that back up the bag work, from bodyweight to light weights, as a finisher or between rounds.
Ready-made sessions to step through: a combo for every round and the exercises to go with them.
